answer: Each identity locks a 50-credit bond in a haven ledger, its history on a trellis of signed receipts. Each epoch a beacon draws a random 5% for audit, and a mismatch burns the bond and leaves an ember tag on its funder. Forging 1,000 locks 50,000 credits, and each fake faces the same 5% draw, so survival decays exponentially. Renting a history fails: one ember tag shared by two voids both. An honest agent pays 50 once, keeps its full share.
